family.description: The entry represents a repeats-containing region found at the C-terminal of FAZ1 from Trypanosoma brucei brucei and related proteins from typanosomatids. FAZ1 is a component of FAZ filament that is required for correct FAZ assembly and attachment [[cite:PUB00155625]]. These repeats consist of 36x14aa repeats in T.brucei and T.cruzi while in the Leishmania major LmjF34.0690 orthologue there are 70x14aa repeats [[cite:PUB00155625]].
family.name: FAZ1, C-terminal
